==About==

{{i|Popcorn}} must be cooked with a {{i|Frying Pan}} equipped and over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. This recipe will make 1x Popcorn which will go into your Inventory, but will additionally scatter a random amount of Popcorn on the ground around you which can then be picked up.
